# ALVA Developer Preview

This is the first user-facing packaged preview of ALVA, an experimental
agent-native programming system. It is a research prototype, not a stable
production toolchain.

The preview packages the compiler state derived from the immutable
`confirmatory-01-treatment-v0.14.1` research snapshot. The research tag itself
has not been moved or rewritten.

## Included

- typed, content-addressed AIR and transactional AEP editing;
- semantic views, impact inspection, typed holes, and construction operations;
- source checking and Rust code generation;
- native and WASM/WASI targets;
- Windows x64, Linux x64, and macOS Apple Silicon binaries;
- SHA-256 checksums for every binary archive.

## Toolchain boundary

The prebuilt `alva` binary can check programs and use AIR/AEP operations without
building ALVA from source. `alva build` and `alva run` generate and compile Rust,
so they still require a Rust toolchain. WASM output additionally requires the
`wasm32-wasip1` Rust target. Run `alva doctor` to inspect these dependencies.

Please report reproducible issues with the command, input, platform, and
structured diagnostics when available.
